name: Imprisonment
description:
Casting time: 1 minute.

Once per rest: Roll Spirit vs Spirit against a creature within medium range. If you are outside your Sanctum, your roll is ill-favored and the creature's roll is favored. On a loss, you cannot target the creature with this spell ever again. On a win, choose one of the following effects:

  • Burial: The creature is entombed far beneath the earth in a sphere of magical force that is just large enough to contain it. Nothing can pass through the sphere, nor can any creature use magic or phased-out movement to get into or out of it.

  • Chaining: Heavy, immovable, indestructible chains, firmly rooted in the ground, hold the creature in place.

  • Prison: The spell transports the target into a demiplane that is warded against teleportation. The demiplane can be a labyrinth, a cage, a tower, or any similar confined structure or area of your choice.

  • Minimus Containment: The target shrinks to a height of 1 inch and is imprisoned inside a gemstone or other small object of your choosing. Light can pass through the object normally, but nothing else can pass through, even by means of teleportation. The object can't be cut or broken while the spell remains in effect.

  • Slumber: The target falls asleep and can't be awoken.

While the effect lasts, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Spells can't locate or perceive the target.

When you cast the spell, you may define a condition that will cause the spell to end and release the target.

You can use each of the above effects to create and maintain only one prison at a time. If you cast this spell and choose the same effect again, the previously imprisoned creature is immediately freed.

Describe the imprisonment.
